scientific_integrity: The original model and its degree-independent crossover equation are explicitly credited to de Kemmeter et al. (arXiv:2305.03879v1, Appendix B). New claimed results are the global at-most-one suppressive interval, unique sharp group-exposure threshold, square-root interval onset, and realization of two crossings. Verification code checks exact identities and examples but does not constitute an infinite-domain proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a homogeneous deterministic, independently signed triangle mean-field model; mean pairwise degree varies with mean triangle incidence held fixed; all degree-order statements require beta_1*(1-eta)*k>mu. No finite-network extinction, adversarial sign-correlation, or bistable-branch theorem. Closely extends the published degree-neutrality equation; exhaustive priority search and independent audit not performed.
title: A sharp triangle-exposure threshold for one connectivity-suppression window in signed social contagion
